tagline: Study, quiz, and exam modes for English-Hebrew vocabulary
short_description: A FastAPI + SQLite web app with five English/Hebrew vocabulary lessons, study/quiz/exam modes, saved scores, and a dummy-gated admin area for editing lessons and vocab.
long_description: A simple web application for learning English <-> Hebrew vocabulary. It ships five seeded lessons (10 vocab items each) with study, quiz, and exam modes, persists quiz/exam attempts as per-lesson score history, and includes a dummy-gated admin area for adding and editing lessons and vocabulary. The frontend is a plain HTML/CSS/JS single-page app using locally hosted Bootstrap 5.3.3, and the backend is a FastAPI service backed by SQLite, which serves the SPA and owns all application state. The repository contains two experiments: the primary client/server app built via a 9-stage decomposed role pipeline, and a single-pass static SPA proof-of-concept with hardcoded vocabulary under proof-of-concept/. README status is PASS based on a curl-driven API verification and static frontend review; known limitations include a dummy admin gate and in-memory tokens that don't survive restarts.
notes: Dossier live probe returned an empty list (no live URLs) and has_pages is false, so live_url is null and has_live_demo is false. No CNAME or hosting config found in the tree. Repo frames itself as two experiments; created and pushed the same day with 0 stars. Frontend verified by static review rather than browser automation.
